execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."acompanante" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "personaId" text NOT NULL,
  "reservaId" text NOT NULL,
  "tipoHuesped" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "acompanante_tipoHuesped_check_868d10e0" CHECK ("tipoHuesped" IN ('ADULTO', 'NINO', 'BEBE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."alojamiento" (
  "capacidad" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" text,
  "estado" text DEFAULT 'OPERATIVO' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "nombre" text NOT NULL,
  "tipo" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "alojamiento_estado_check_d2557066" CHECK ("estado" IN ('OPERATIVO', 'MANTENIMIENTO', 'FUERA_SERVICIO')),
  CONSTRAINT "alojamiento_tipo_check_f0bfe4af" CHECK ("tipo" IN ('HABITACION', 'CABANA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."persona" (
  "contacto" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documento" text NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "eps" text,
  "fechaNacimiento" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "nombre" text NOT NULL,
  "tipoDocumento" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "persona_tipoDocumento_check_0a53733e" CHECK ("tipoDocumento" IN ('CC', 'CE', 'TI', 'PASAPORTE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."plan" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "nombre" text NOT NULL,
  "precio" float8 NOT NULL,
  "soloParejas" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."planServicio" (
  "planId" text NOT NULL,
  "servicioId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("planId", "servicioId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."programacionPlan" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fechaFin" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "fechaInicio" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "observaciones" text,
  "planId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."reserva" (
  "alojamientoId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "estado" text DEFAULT 'PENDIENTE_PAGO' NOT NULL,
  "fechaIngreso" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "fechaSalida" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "observaciones" text,
  "planId" text NOT NULL,
  "precioPlan" float8 NOT NULL,
  "titularId" text NOT NULL,
  "total" float8 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "reserva_estado_check_dca8981a" CHECK ("estado" IN ('PENDIENTE_PAGO', 'CONFIRMADA', 'CANCELADA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."reservaServicio" (
  "cantidad" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "precio" float8 NOT NULL,
  "reservaId" text NOT NULL,
  "servicioId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("reservaId", "servicioId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."servicio" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "nombre" text NOT NULL,
  "precio" float8 NOT NULL,
  "soloRomantico" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
